title: Adventurous Scavenger Hunt in Kelowna by Crazy Dash
includes: 2 hours with a remote interactive guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Kelowna with Crazy Dash! Our scavenger takes you around the city to find items and perform tasks for points. You'll use an app on your phone that will allow you to collect points! Check the rankings during and after you play to see your score and compare it to others. All our Scavenger hunts have a live remote host to help along the way. Come out and explore with us in Kelowna.
